A '''refinery''' was built by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]] to mine the valuable chemical [[venenit queshaaga]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. However, contaminants polluted the refining process, causing the processed chemical&mdash;more commonly known as Quesh venom&mdash;to eat through the refinery's vats and the floor of the building. The refinery was heavily damaged by the incident, leading the Republic to build a [[Quesh Venom Refinery|new refinery]]<ref name="Codex" /> by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3642 BBY]].<ref name="Time" />

==Behind the scenes==
The first refinery was first mentioned in the Codex entry for the Quesh Venom Refinery in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
